plugins.name: chiron
plugins.description: Chiron — the methodological companion of the tekton corpus: a peer persona that holds the session and carries five grammars (Kentauros, Dialektikē, Genesis, Praxis, Aisthesis) as skills. For work on methods, workspaces and the gestures that animate them.

plugins.name: kyklos
plugins.description: Kyklos — the unified cycle of learning and production. Three profiles sharing one trunk: Elasis (swift), Anabasis (production refinement), Organon (knowledge refinement).

plugins.name: kairos
plugins.description: Kairos — an attention allocation system held by an AI guardian. Partitions, balance, inflections, backlog, journal; three task natures and nine gestures.

plugins.name: agora
plugins.description: Agora — the guardian of the whole. Keeps a living corpus coherent from a piece's birth to its consumer: an instance file declares what leaves, every exit reviews it with the user; six gestures, one file per target system.

plugins.name: prosopon
plugins.description: Prosopon — the persona as an object: what a persona is, its two typical forms, and what changes when one is forged — the six questions of its Position, three layers in two registers at its Forge, a trial in situation at its acceptance. A method grafted onto Kyklos, speaking at the entry of three gestures.
